authority: User requests creative research and fresh reframing locally and on Kaggle, faster adaptations of B300 ideas, disk-only storage and new best submissions.
question: Which inexpensive adaptation of the B300 research can improve a complete deterministic submission within the remaining local/Kaggle allocation?
deliverable: A bounded, independently graded screen, followed by an actual native evaluated ZIP if evidence and remaining production budget support it; preserve unsuccessful outcomes.
baseline: TL3 exact archive d80e69d3cb52d8ee45158fc8d0f3a8af232b029b07ca5b313c61cffef029e569; user-reported public 0.66832. Clean fold-specific comparators must be named in the frozen scientific recipe.

verification.correctness: A: deterministic source, causality, state, cache and package checks
verification.local_quality: B: repeated empirical evaluation on exposed source-qualified folds
verification.public_transfer: C: local gains do not guarantee unseen competition improvement
verification.metric: unchanged global_wp_clip2_v1, both targets, complete declared folds, paired component uncertainty
verification.exposure: All existing validation folds are exposed. No new holdout claim. Parent/teacher/preprocessing fitting membership must exclude evaluated groups for clean comparisons.

allocation.funding: Latest user steering reprioritizes up to 7200 seconds of the 16235.769012763001 unused strong-parent stage toward a fast B300-derived screen. This is within the existing 28800-second stage and 108000-second total, not a new grant.
allocation.screen_design: Freeze 4–6 total fits in matched cells after independent proposals and actual sustained profile. Exact reused controls and all teacher costs must be explicit.
allocation.kaggle: Read fresh quota and reservations; launch only a complete useful bounded job that fits verified availability. CPU-only Kaggle is eligible. No paid compute or B300 execution.
allocation.old_online_panel: Original terminal receipt and unapproved extension preserved. This contract does not extend or restart that panel.

resources.precision: strict FP32, autocast and TF32 disabled
resources.storage: All new scratch/cache/artifacts on verified physical disk; TMPDIR/TMP/TEMP and library caches point here. No /tmp or /dev/shm use. Existing disk artifacts remain readable without moving or copying large payloads.
resources.entry_observation: No research service active; CPU package92C, GPU66C, task/hostswap0, disk73GBavailable. Unrelated editor cpptools is busy; leave it untouched.
resources.thermal: Require CPU package below90C and GPU below80C before heavy admission. CPU package and GPU monitoring must gate execution, with cooling/abort and elapsed time charged. Do not rely on GPU temperature alone.

ownership.root: contract, allocation, source freeze, admission, integration, synthesis and release
ownership.b300_scout: audit actual B300 evidence and propose a fast reusable implementation, source-only initially
ownership.reframe: independent primary-source/random-library hypotheses with committed first proposals
ownership.kaggle_ops: read-only fresh provider quota/access/reservations and delivery feasibility, no launch initially
ownership.later: Assign actor and independent critic/grader before scientific execution; actor may not mutate grader, recipe or allocation.

selection_and_stopping.primary_comparison: Freeze one selected mechanism and matched control plus fixed complete blend before reading new scores.
selection_and_stopping.cost_gate: Inclusive profile/fit/export/grade projection must fit7200seconds with thermal slowdown; defer or explicitly redesign before fitting if it cannot.
selection_and_stopping.science: Useful consistent endpoint gain can merit follow-up despite an interval crossing zero; improved auxiliary/input loss alone cannot promote a submission.
selection_and_stopping.abort: Causality/ancestry/source/coverage failure, nonfinite behavior, unsafe memory/temperature, or cap reached.
selection_and_stopping.release: Actual native endpoint quality, deterministic callback/reset, size, ABI and runtime required. No public-score forecast from a local delta. No competition upload.
